pages.title: Tint in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A color with a meaning, which every theme has its own version of.

pages.title: Value in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A value: what fields hold and expressions compute.

pages.title: ViewKind in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What a view shows.

pages.title: audit_entity in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The entity of the audit trail, which storage has to know when there is one.

pages.title: check_model in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What in a model points to nothing, in words for whoever changed it: a view of an entity that is gone, a column of a field that is not there, a menu item with no view.

pages.title: check_query in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Says whether a query fits an entity.

pages.title: check_transitions in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Whether a change keeps to the state machines of its entity. Whoever keeps records calls this with what is stored and what is about to be, before writing, as every space here does.

pages.title: environment in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What an expression is evaluated with: the language and what was added to it.

pages.title: generate_model in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The model the entities give: their members, a list, a list to pick from and a form for each, and the navigation.

pages.title: hash_password in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What is kept for a password: Argon2id, with its parameters and a salt of its own, in the usual text form. A new v4 UUID is 122 random bits from the system.

pages.title: key_of in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The key of a record, as text.

pages.title: key_text in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A key as text, the same for equal keys.

pages.title: live_expose in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Registers this crate’s types with a playground’s interpreter (feature `live`).

pages.title: local_now in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The date and time on this machine, as people read it on a clock.

pages.title: merge_changes in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Puts together what a person changed, from `original` to `mine`, and what is `stored` now. Changes to different fields both stand, so only changing the same field takes a decision.

pages.title: register_function in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Adds a function to expressions in rules, appearance, actions, calculated fields and filters. An application’s state is of one thread, and so is this. A filter with one runs in memory, as the database does not know it.

pages.title: reminders_of in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The records of an entity with a reminder that have a time set, for this person, as this space shows them. What is due by now is up to whoever asks, as they know the time.

pages.title: run_query in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Runs a query over records in memory: computes, filters, sorts and takes the page.

pages.title: security_entities in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The entities of users, roles and permissions, which storage has to know.

pages.title: validate in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Checks a record against the rules of its entity that apply in this context. It does not run by itself: forms call it before keeping, and anything else that writes calls it itself.

pages.title: validate_in_place in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The same, leaving out rules that have to read other records, for checking every row of a list.

pages.title: verify_password in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Whether this password is the one this was made from. Something unreadable matches nothing.

pages.title: Action in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Something people can do. A handle: the frame and its controller hold the same action, so a controller can turn it off by a reason of its own.

pages.title: ActionContext in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What an action sees while running. A copy is the same run: what it asks for next counts.

pages.title: Appearance in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What the rules that apply come to.

pages.title: AppearanceRule in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Changes how things look or behave, for records that meet a condition. It is about looks: it does not protect data, which is what permissions are for.

pages.title: Application in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: An application put together: its entities, its model and what makes frames. Layers from the administrator and the user go on with `layers_mut`.

pages.title: ApplicationBuilder in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Collects what goes in an `Application`.

pages.title: AuditSettings in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What the audit trail covers.

pages.title: AuditTrail in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What the audit trail needs: what it covers, who is acting, and what to add to the next commit.

pages.title: AuditedObjectSpace in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A unit of work that writes what it commits to the audit trail, in the same commit, so a change and its trail stay or go together. Changes made to the database some other way are not seen.

pages.title: ChangeSet in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What a unit of work has waiting, for whoever implements one: new, changed and deleted records, one change per record.

pages.title: ChoiceItem in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: One option of a single-choice action, which can hold others.

pages.title: Credentials in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What someone gave to sign in.

pages.title: DashboardInfo in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Other views together. It is bound to no records: each piece keeps its own frame.

pages.title: DashboardItem in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A piece of a dashboard.

pages.title: Diff in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A difference over the layers below it, as JSON: an object is a node, by id, and anything else is a setting.

pages.title: EmbeddedStore in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A difference that came inside the program, as a module’s does. It cannot change.

pages.title: EntityInfo in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A kind of record.

pages.title: EnumOption in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: One of the values of a `FieldKind::Enum`.

pages.title: FieldInfo in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A field of an `EntityInfo`.

pages.title: FileStorage in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Pieces of data kept as files in a folder on the desktop, one file per name. A write goes to a draft first and then takes the file’s place, so a crash never leaves half a file.

pages.title: FileStore in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A difference in a file. A failure while saving leaves the old file whole.

pages.title: Frame in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Where a view lives: it holds the view, the controllers that fit it, their actions and a unit of work. A handle, so controllers and actions can keep one.

pages.title: Identity in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Who is using the application.

pages.title: Job in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A job that started, as the screen sees it. A handle: the frame keeps one while it runs.

pages.title: JobContext in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What a job sees while it runs, on its own thread.

pages.title: ListFilter in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A filter ready for people to pick from a menu on a list.

pages.title: MemoryAttachmentStore in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Files that last as long as the program, as on the web with no server.

pages.title: MemoryDatabase in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Records kept in memory, on desktop and in the browser. Any number of spaces share them, and each sees what the others committed.

pages.title: MemoryModelStore in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A difference that lasts as long as the program, where nothing else is at hand.

pages.title: MemoryObjectSpace in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A unit of work over a `MemoryDatabase`.

pages.title: MemoryStorage in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Pieces of data kept in memory, gone when the program ends: for tests and previews.

pages.title: Merged in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What comes of putting together what a person changed and what someone else kept meanwhile.

pages.title: MergedModel in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The model as it stands, with all its layers applied.

pages.title: Message in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Something to tell people, which goes away by itself.

pages.title: ModelError in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Something wrong in how the application was declared, in words for its developer.

pages.title: ModelLayers in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The generated model and the layers over it. Taking a setting off a layer brings back what the layer below says.

pages.title: ModelNode in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A node of the application model: an id, settings and nodes under it.

pages.title: Object in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A record: its entity’s name and a value per field. Dynamic, so filters, rules and permissions read every entity the same way.

pages.title: Permissions in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What one person can do: the answers of their roles, brought together.

pages.title: Query in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What to read: a filter, an order and a page.

pages.title: Reasons in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Why something is on or off: pairs of reason and answer. It is on only if every answer is yes, so one part of the application turning it off cannot be undone by another.

pages.title: RecordAction in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: An action of an entity that sets fields of the records selected.

pages.title: Reminder in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The field of a record that says when to remind people of it, and what to say.

pages.title: Role in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A set of permissions a person can have.

pages.title: Rule in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: One thing a record has to meet, in some contexts, and perhaps only when it fits.

pages.title: RuleWords in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The words of what fails, where `{0}` is the name of the field.

pages.title: SecuredObjectSpace in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A unit of work that only does what the person signed in can do, whoever asks: a screen, an action or a call with no screen around it.

pages.title: SecurityContext in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Who is signed in and what the security system needs to answer for them. One per signed-in person, shared by their units of work.

pages.title: StateMachine in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The states of a record, in one of its fields, and the ways between them.

pages.title: StoredModel in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The person’s own settings kept in a `Storage` under a name: a file on the desktop, the browser’s IndexedDB on the web, beside the records.

pages.title: TargetScope in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Which views an action or a controller is for. Anything left out does not narrow it.

pages.title: Transition in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A way from one state to another.

pages.title: UnusableNode in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A part of a difference that has no node to land on, as after the entity it refers to is gone. It is kept, and comes back into use if the node does.

pages.title: UserDirectory in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: The people who can sign in, kept as records.

pages.title: ViewInfo in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A view, as the model describes it.

pages.title: ViewVariant in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Another way to see the list of an entity, which people pick from a menu once there are two.

pages.title: Violation in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A rule that was not met.

pages.title: AttachmentStore in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Keeps the content of files, and gives a key for each. A record holds only that key, so reading a list does not read every file.

pages.title: Authenticator in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A way of signing in. Passwords are `UserDirectory`; a way that talks to an outside provider, as OAuth 2 does, implements this and asks `UserDirectory::identity_of` for the roles.

pages.title: BusinessObject in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A record as a Rust struct. Derive it:

pages.title: FieldValue in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A Rust type a field can have.

pages.title: ModelStore in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Keeps one layer’s difference.

pages.title: Module in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A part of an application: what it adds, in one place. Modules stack, each over those it depends on.

pages.title: ObjectSpace in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: A unit of work over records: what it reads includes its own changes, and nothing reaches storage until `commit`. A view has one of these, so canceling a form throws away only that form’s changes.

pages.title: ObjectSpaceExt in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Reading and writing with Rust structs, on any object space.

pages.title: Storage in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Named pieces of data kept between runs.

pages.title: ViewController in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Behavior tied to a view: it turns on when a view it targets is shown, and off when that goes. Its actions are off while it is off. Each frame has its own.

pages.title: WindowController in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Behavior tied to a window, whatever view it shows. Stays on while the frame lasts.

pages.title: JobWaker in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Something that wakes the screen, from any thread.

pages.title: JobWork in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: What a background action does: it reads what it was given, does its work and tells as it goes. An error ends it, in words for people.

pages.title: SpaceMaker in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Makes a unit of work with no permissions around it. It only ever goes to what needs to read before anyone has signed in, or to what the security system does itself.

pages.title: SpaceWatcher in ravenrs_app - Rust
pages.description: Watches a space; see `ObjectSpace::on_event`.

pages.description: Something on a `EventCalendar`’s day.

pages.description: Slides with previous/next buttons, position dots and optional autoplay.

pages.description: A chart’s card: its title and description, what changes it, and what it says at the bottom, such as how it compares to last month.

pages.description: A dashed line across a `Chart` at a value that matters, such as a target.

pages.title: ChartTooltip in ravenrs_widgets - Rust

pages.title: Checkbox in ravenrs_widgets - Rust
pages.description: A check box with a label.

pages.description: A table column: title, relative width and alignment.

pages.title: Combobox in ravenrs_widgets - Rust
pages.description: A select with a search box: type to filter the options.

pages.title: Command in ravenrs_widgets - Rust
pages.description: An action in the `CommandPalette`.
